{{Quote|Borvo had one of his biggest gun sales in a long time to some guys on Corellia. It turns out it was a setup by the CorSec cops. Most of our guys are either dead or in jail now, except for Dagorel, Borvo's right hand guy.|[[Borvo's guard]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BtHG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Borvo The Hutt's Guard|Naboo}}</ref>}}
'''Dagorel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] criminal who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Dagorel's been shot. I need you to deliver a medpack to him. Be careful, I don't know if there are any thugs hanging out around there.|Borvo's guard, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Dagorel was employed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]] as his main lieutenant.<ref name="SWG:BtHG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Dagorel participated to an important illegal weapon sale near [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]]. However, the sale was in fact an undercover [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] operation of the [[Corellian Security Force]] and all Borvo's men but Dagorel were killed or arrested during the operation. The Quarren luckily escaped but was shot in the ambush and severely injured.<ref name="SWG:BtHG" /> When the rest of the gang discovered the situation, [[Borvo's guard|Borvo's bodyguard]] sent a spacer with medicine to rescue Dagorel in the [[Paitnnu Wetlands]], and thus saved his life. Dagorel later discovered that he was trapped during that mission by one of Borvo's most trusted men known as [[Niksel Frangee]]. The spacer who saved Dagorel was thus tasked to assassinate Frangee. Borvo's guard, Dagorel and the spacer finally found that Frangee was an infiltrated agent of the Corellian Security Force.<ref name="SWG:BGATTC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Borvo's Guard - A Trip To Corellia|Naboo}}</ref> Dagorel later discovered that Frangee entered [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|Borvo's organization]] thanks to one of Borvo's former business partner known as [[Montrus]].<ref name="SWG:BA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Borvo's Assignments|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempCommonerRodianMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Dagorel prior to the 2005 update.]]
Dagorel appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Dagorel was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline (pre-NGE)|Borvo the Hutt's questline]].<ref name="SWG:BtHG" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Borvo the Hutt's questline was [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline|revamped]]. While the gameplay of the questline was extensively upgraded, the storyline remained similar.<ref name="SWG:BG" /> With this update, Dagorel had his appearance changed from a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]<ref name="SWG:BtHG" /> to a Quarren.<ref name="SWG:BG" />
